usage: llm-modelbench campaign run [-h] --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID
                                   [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                   [--level {smoke,short,full}]
                                   [--categories CATEGORIES] [--tasks TASKS]
                                   [--task-regex TASK_REGEX]
                                   [--family-base-only]
                                   [--context-aliases-only] [--context-only]
                                   [--allow-host-code-execution]
                                   [--models MODELS | --all | --select]
                                   [--auto | --no-auto-probe]
                                   [--include-regex INCLUDE_REGEX]
                                   [--exclude-regex EXCLUDE_REGEX]
                                   [--skip-offload] [--ctx CTX]
                                   [--num-predict NUM_PREDICT]
                                   [--think {auto,on,off}]
                                   [--needle-max-ctx NEEDLE_MAX_CTX]
                                   [--judge-model JUDGE_MODEL]
                                   [--samples SAMPLES]
                                   [--sample-mode {smart,all}] [--mock]
                                   [--plan-json PLAN_JSON]
                                   [--judge {single,panel,off}]
                                   [--dump-subjective] [--no-dump]
                                   [--dump-raw] [--no-dump-raw]
                                   [--fingerprint] [--no-fingerprint]
                                   [--resume] [--no-resume] [--yes]
                                   [--status-interval STATUS_INTERVAL]
                                   [--live-ui {off,compact,full,graph,log}]
                                   [--strict-harness] [--unattended-safe]
                                   [--unattended]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --campaign-id CAMPAIGN_ID
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --level {smoke,short,full}
  --categories CATEGORIES
                        comma-separated category filter
  --tasks TASKS         comma-separated task IDs to run, e.g.
                        py_anagram,json_extract,needle
  --task-regex TASK_REGEX
                        regex over task id/category/scorer, e.g.
                        needle|context
  --family-base-only    skip obvious context aliases such as 64k/128k/ctx/exp
                        variants
  --context-aliases-only
                        run only obvious context aliases such as
                        64k/128k/ctx/exp variants
  --context-only        run only long-context/needle tasks; combine with
                        --context-aliases-only for alias validation
  --allow-host-code-execution
                        explicitly permit deterministic scorers to execute
                        model-generated Python/JavaScript on this host; use
                        only inside a disposable container or VM
  --models MODELS       exact installed model names separated by semicolons
  --all                 explicitly select every model returned by Ollama (also
                        the default when no selector is given)
  --select              interactive MODEL selector only; test scope still
                        comes from --level/--categories/--tasks
  --auto                run small functional capability probes before routing
                        tasks
  --no-auto-probe       route from metadata/operator profiles only; skips pre-
                        run functional probes
  --include-regex INCLUDE_REGEX
  --exclude-regex EXCLUDE_REGEX
  --skip-offload        skip models that exceed the VRAM budget
  --ctx CTX             override Ollama num_ctx for all chat calls in this run
  --num-predict NUM_PREDICT
                        override Ollama num_predict for all normal task
                        generations
  --think {auto,on,off}
                        control Ollama thinking where supported; auto leaves
                        server/model default
  --needle-max-ctx NEEDLE_MAX_CTX
                        operator safety cap for needle probe num_ctx; larger
                        probes are skipped and coverage drops
  --judge-model JUDGE_MODEL
                        local Ollama model used for subjective judging,
                        default from config/env
  --samples SAMPLES     requested runs per sampled task; smart mode applies
                        this only to judged tasks
  --sample-mode {smart,all}
                        smart=sample only subjective/judged tasks; all=old
                        behavior, sample every task
  --mock                run fully offline against a deterministic stub
  --plan-json PLAN_JSON
                        write the computed plan JSON to this path
  --judge {single,panel,off}
  --dump-subjective
  --no-dump
  --dump-raw
  --no-dump-raw
  --fingerprint
  --no-fingerprint
  --resume
  --no-resume
  --yes
  --status-interval STATUS_INTERVAL
  --live-ui {off,compact,full,graph,log}
  --strict-harness
  --unattended-safe     write terminal readiness and review package without
                        host mutation
  --unattended          use the unattended decision policy: complete without
                        interactive stdin where a decision is explicitly safe
                        to make automatically (e.g. a decisive backend
                        recommendation), otherwise fail closed with a typed
                        reason. Independent of --yes/--unattended-safe/--auto-
                        confirm, which keep their existing meanings and are
                        not implied by this flag.
